registration_scope: Closing-stage analysis plan; not a preregistration before experiments or before viewing their results.
purpose: Per-training-seed paired user uncertainty for appendix forest plots. Does not replace or pool with the separate three-training-seed Student-t intervals.
paired_unit: same test sample/user/target under a fixed method checkpoint and its same-training-seed Control checkpoint; one sample per user
populations: full and affected for all measured methods; additionally pooled and singleton for LBSP
effect: method-minus-Control per-user rank-derived metric, then user mean
Ensemble: Compute each user's metric in each of five final score-mean recommendation groups, average these five per-user metrics, subtract the same user's canonical Control metric. The five groups remain fixed in user resampling.
bootstrap: nonparametric paired user bootstrap with replacement; sample n user indices for each replicate, using shared indices across all seven metrics in a dataset/method/trainingseed/population cell
cell_rng_seed: unsigned integer from first 8 big-endian bytes of SHA256('20261027|dataset|method|trainingseed|population')
rng: NumPy Generator with explicit PCG64 bit generator; NumPy version recorded
interval: 2.5th and 97.5th percentiles of bootstrap means; NumPy quantile method=linear
all_zero_pairs: Known exact-zero distribution; report zero bounds without allocating random draws, B remains the specified 2000 constant replicates
scope_and_limitations: Conditional on the fixed data sampling framework, checkpoints, chosen training seed, selected epoch and fixed permutation/ensemble groups. User exchangeability is assumed. Does not include training-seed variation, checkpoint-selection uncertainty, correlated interaction dependence or uncertainty in choosing perturbations. No multiple-comparison correction. Monte Carlo approximation with B=2000. These are descriptive intervals and not confirmatory significance or causal evidence.
forbidden: combining users across training seeds as independent training runs
using per-seed user intervals as the three-seed Figure5 interval
counting ensemble groups as independent training runs
